C0978.title: Newbee Dota 2 Match-Fixing Scandal
C0978.summary: In January 2021, Dota 2's official announcement imposed penalties on Newbee Club and its members Moogy, AQ, Wizard, Waixi, and Faith. The announcement stated that Valve and Perfect World Esports permanently banned the club and these individuals from participating in official Dota 2 events hosted by Valve and Perfect World Esports, effective January 1, 2021. The case illustrates long-term tournament bans used to address integrity risks such as match-fixing in esports.
